item.title: Wringing Hope From the Rubble of Gaza
item.description: The cease-fire last October ostensibly brought an end to Israel’s war in Gaza after the Hamas-led attacks on Oct. 7, 2023. A year later, however, Israeli strikes, though less frequent, haven’t stopped.

item.media:description: It’s been a year since Israel and Hamas signed an agreement to end the war in Gaza. But life in Gaza looks nothing like peace.

item.title: Palestinian Authority Formally Delays Elections, Despite Western Pressure
